raw_answer_text:
Looking at the validator error: `edge` in the `flowchart` genre doesn't accept a bare trailing string as a positional label — it needs to be passed as a keyed argument. Fixing both occurrences:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "BGP session reset procedure"

process checkcounters "Check interface error counters"
decision errorsfound "Errors found?"
process clearcounters "Clear interface counters"
terminator monitor "Monitor session"
terminator escalate "Escalate to operator"

edge checkcounters -> errorsfound
edge errorsfound -> clearcounters label="yes"
edge errorsfound -> escalate label="no"
edge clearcounters -> monitor
```

Change made: replaced the bare trailing strings `"yes"` / `"no"` on the two branch edges with the keyed form `label="yes"` / `label="no"`, since `edge` takes labels as a named argument, not a positional one, under `flowchart`. All other structure (nodes, ids, and connections) is unchanged from the prior attempt, matching the described procedure: `checkcounters → errorsfound`, `errorsfound` branching yes→`clearcounters`→`monitor` and no→`escalate`.
